{"design":"# Plan: mimid-1wgh.12 — JMAP MIMI capability (urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:mimi)

Approved by Mark 2026-10-17.

## Mark's decisions
- Spec draft `draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00.md` lives in ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec (kramdown-rfc style of draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00). ASK MARK before each write to that repo.
- URN: urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:mimi.
- Types crate `jmap-mimi-types` lives in ~/PROJECT/crate-jmap (MIT OR Apache-2.0). ASK MARK before each write to that repo.
- Provider DECODES protocol-06 responses into JMAP errors/results (where a response part is encrypted to the device, e.g. GroupInfoResponse's tree/GroupInfo, the status is decoded and the encrypted part passed through).
- Handshake fanouts delivered as Messages with bodyType application/mimi-fanout (one ordered stream; push/WSS unchanged). senderMsgId for fanouts: ULID time = hub-accepted ms, randomness = SHA-256(FanoutMessage bytes)[0..10].
- Room ID and MLS group ID: both random, independent (16 random bytes, base32); hub maps them; fresh group ID per MLS group; users see display name. Verify whether protocol-06 constrains MLS group_id bytes; DR if so.
- Creator's other devices join only by external join (one path, same as new devices).
- Last-resort KeyPackages in v1.
- All of a user's devices receive a Welcome Message; each opens only its own part. Acceptable.

## Prior art
- jmap-chat-spec CORE E2EE mode (body ciphertext uninspected L582; server-set senderMsgId L572; relay model L1655-1676); VTC e2ee guide L171-179 (JMAP server as MLS DS, handshakes as messages).
- agora spec/05-messaging.md §5.2.1.1 KeyPackage rules: single-use atomic consume; one per device per fetch; last-resort returned only when nothing else, not consumed; reject re-upload of a stored KP.
- crate-jmap: jmap_server::Dispatcher::register(method, Arc<dyn JmapHandler>); capability consts+struct pattern (crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs, jmap-cid-types); check_known_capabilities; Message.body_type is a free string.

## Data model
Byte payloads: base64url of exact protocol-06/MLS TLS bytes (client signs KeyMaterialRequest/GroupInfoRequest; hub encrypts GroupInfoResponse to client HPKE key).
Account capability: hubSender (provider ExternalSender), cipherSuites [1], maxKeyPackages.
| Method/object | Drives |
|---|---|
| KeyPackage {id, keyPackage, keyPackageRef (server-set), lastResort}; /get, /set (create, destroy); StateChange on consumption | target side of keyMaterial; keyPackageRef routes Welcomes (§5.5 NOTE) |
| KeyMaterial/fetch {roomId, request} -> decoded result | POST /keyMaterial via hub (§5.2) |
| Room/create {groupInfo} -> {roomId, chatId} | provider-local creation (§3.1); provider becomes hub |
| Room/update {roomId, request} -> decoded result | POST /update (§5.3), incl. external commits |
| GroupInfo/fetch {roomId, request} -> decoded status + encrypted payload | POST /groupInfo (§5.6) |
| Message/set create, bodyType application/mimi-content, body = PrivateMessage (spec text must say so) | submitMessage (§5.4); accepted_timestamp -> sentAt; SetErrors notAllowed, epochTooOld{currentEpoch} |
| Message bodyType application/mimi-fanout, body = FanoutMessage bytes | inbound notify; Welcome creates the invitee's Chat first |
| Chat.roomId (server-set) | room ops |

## Flows ([J] JMAP, [M] MIMI)
Create room: A1 reads hubSender [J]; builds group with participant_list + room_metadata; Room/create [J]; A's other devices see Chat and external-join.
Invite Bob@B: B1 KeyPackage/set [J] earlier; A1 KeyMaterial/fetch [J] -> A /keyMaterial/bob [M] -> B consumes + records refs; A1 Commit (AppDataUpdate participant_list + Adds) + Welcome + GroupInfo via Room/update [J]; A /notify [M] Welcome->B, Commit->followers, stores Commit as Message; B creates Chat, stores Welcome; B1 WSS [J] -> Message/get -> joins; replenish on KeyPackage StateChange.
Send: B1 Message/set [J] -> B /submitMessage [M] -> A accepts -> /notify [M] -> each provider stores + WSS [J].
External join (B2): GroupInfo/fetch [J] -> /groupInfo [M]; external commit via Room/update [J] -> /update [M] -> /notify [M].
Leave: Room/update [J] with SelfRemove + AppDataUpdate removing Bob -> /update [M]; A1 commits; commit also delivered to B1 (§5.5).

## Tests (no self-oracle)
- JSON examples in the draft, written before the types, round-trip byte-for-byte; byte payloads generated by plain OpenMLS, not mimi-mls.
- KeyPackage validation: wrong suite, non-Basic credential, identity mismatch, duplicate -> specific SetErrors; second claim gets a different KP or last-resort; Welcome only to account owning keyPackageRef.
- Two-provider flow tests (under .7): oracle = MLS agreement (epoch_authenticator + exporter equal across members, plaintext equality, removed agent sees removal).
- Duplicate /notify -> exactly one Message.
